Package bg.tu_varna.ks.models

Class Event.EventBuilder

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.ks.models.Event.EventBuilder
Enclosing class:
Event
public static class Event.EventBuilder extends Object
Builder for Event objects.

Implements the Builder pattern - it allows step-by-step field assignment through chained method calls (fluent API) and finally produces a ready, construction-immutable object via build().
